self.text: I’m a young Mexican photographer in my early 20s, shooting with a Nikon. I love climbing, and I’m looking for a structured instruction session—just the shooting, no post‑processing lesson this time. We’ll focus on the camera work, and we’re not taking portraits of each other. I’m free Sunday afternoon if that works for you.
